title: Streamdown: The Streaming-Optimized Markdown Renderer for AI Apps
description:
💡 Meet Streamdown: a streaming-optimized, drop-in replacement for react-markdown.
⚡ Handles incomplete blocks
📊 GFM support
🎨 LaTeX + Mermaid + code highlighting
🛡️ Secure, fast, AI-friendly
👉 Render streaming AI outputs beautifully.
